title: Paneer Paratha
description: Whole-wheat flatbread stuffed with a spiced crumbled-paneer filling and pan-fried until crisp and golden — a filling, weekend breakfast bread.
steps: Knead the flour, water and salt into a soft dough, cover and rest for 15-20 minutes.
In a bowl, mix the crumbled paneer with the onion, green chilli, coriander leaves, cumin powder, red chilli powder and amchur. Season with a little salt and mix well.

Divide the dough into 8 balls and the paneer filling into 8 portions. Roll a dough ball into a small disc, place a portion of filling in the centre, and gather the edges to seal, forming a stuffed ball.
Gently flatten and roll out the stuffed ball into a paratha about 6 inches across, being careful not to let the filling spill out.
Heat a tawa over medium heat. Cook the paratha for about a minute, then flip and drizzle a little ghee on top.
Flip again and drizzle ghee on the other side, pressing gently with a spatula until both sides are golden brown and crisp, 3-4 minutes total.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling. Serve hot with curd or pickle.
